title: RAH-I AŞK Perfume 75ml EDP | A Long-Lasting Fragrance on the Journey of Love
body_html:
RAH-I AŞK PERFUME 75ml EDP | Journey of Love in a Timeless Scent

RAH-I AŞK 75ml Eau de Parfum from Parfumane’s Dolmabahçe Collection is a poetic interpretation of love — its passion, elegance, and eternity — expressed through the art of perfumery. Meaning “The Path of Love” in Ottoman Turkish, this fragrance captures the essence of an emotional journey, from the first spark of attraction to the serene comfort of lasting devotion. Crafted with mandarin, pepper, rose, jasmine, amber, vanilla, and musk, it is both vibrant and deeply soulful.

The Elegance of the Dolmabahçe Collection

Parfumane Dolmabahçe Collection redefines Ottoman luxury with modern artistry. Each perfume bottle is adorned with crystal detailing, a French-style bulb atomizer, and a refillable glass design that merges sustainability with timeless glamour. Rah-i Aşk stands as the emotional centerpiece of the collection — a fragrance that could easily grace the courts of sultans, yet feels at home in modern sophistication. Every element, from its design to its scent, evokes refined romance and artistic heritage.

A Symphony of Citrus, Spice, and Florals

The composition of RAH-I AŞK begins with an invigorating burst of mandarin and pepper, symbolizing the fiery start of love — exciting, daring, and full of promise. These bright top notes quickly soften into a heart of rose and jasmine, a blend that represents emotional depth and tenderness. Beneath, cedarwood provides balance and strength, grounding the fragrance in warmth and stability.

As the scent unfolds, the base reveals its true depth. Amber radiates golden warmth, vanilla adds sweetness and sensuality, and musk envelops the skin with softness. Together, these notes form a lasting memory — a trail of intimacy, grace, and elegance that lingers long after the first impression.

  • Top Notes: Mandarin, Pepper, Iris
  • Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Cedarwood
  • Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla, Musk

The Journey of Love Through Scent

The name “Rah-i Aşk” translates to “The Path of Love,” and the fragrance truly embodies that path — from spark to serenity. Every layer tells a chapter: the fresh top notes capture the thrill of meeting, the floral heart symbolizes harmony and connection, while the base represents the enduring comfort of lifelong love. Rah-i Aşk is more than a perfume — it’s a story written in scent, unique to every wearer.

Longevity and Sillage

With its EDP concentration, this perfume offers remarkable staying power and elegant projection. The first hours radiate brightness and energy; later, it becomes intimate and comforting. Longevity: 10–14 hours on average. It’s a fragrance that transforms gracefully throughout the day, adapting to both daylight elegance and evening romance. Perfect for those who seek a scent that expresses both strength and tenderness.

The Bottle: Handcrafted Beauty

Rah-i Aşk is presented in a bottle worthy of its royal inspiration. The crystal-cut detailing reflects Ottoman artistry, while the golden French-style atomizer adds a nostalgic touch. The refillable glass bottle and carefully designed box — inspired by Dolmabahçe Palace motifs — make it a statement of sustainable luxury. This is not just a perfume to wear, but an heirloom to display.

The Spirit of Istanbul

RAH-I AŞK captures the romantic heart of Istanbul — where the morning sun reflects on the Bosphorus, and the air carries whispers of spice, wood, and blooming flowers. The mandarin recalls the freshness of the city’s mornings, while pepper and cedar evoke its historical warmth. Rose and jasmine bring forth the charm of Ottoman gardens, and amber-musk provides a lingering sense of serenity. This perfume is the scent of Istanbul itself — timeless, passionate, and endlessly beautiful.

How to Apply

  • Daytime: 2–3 sprays on neck and wrists for a fresh, romantic aura.
  • Evening: 4–5 sprays on clothing or chest for a rich, alluring presence.
  • Layering Tip: Combine with musk-based perfumes for warmth or floral scents for brightness.

Care & Storage

Store the perfume in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. On dry skin, apply an unscented moisturizer before use to enhance projection and longevity. title: LALEZAR PARFÜM 75ml EDP | Çiçek Bahçelerinin Zarafetiyle
body_html:
LALEZAR PARFÜM 75ml EDP | Çiçek Bahçelerinin Zarafetiyle

LALEZAR 75ml Eau de Parfum, Parfumane Dolmabahçe Koleksiyonu’nun zarif ve romantik ruhunu temsil eden özel bir eserdir. İsmini, Osmanlı döneminde “çiçeklerle dolu bahçe” anlamına gelen Lalezar kelimesinden alan bu parfüm, zarafet, zariflik ve huzurun kokuya dönüştüğü bir şiirdir. Gül ağacı, şeftali, yasemin, gül ve iris gibi çiçeksi notalarla açılırken, alt tabanda tonka, vanilya ve misk birleşerek sıcak, duygusal bir derinlik kazandırır. Her püskürtmede adeta bahar sabahının tazeliğini hissettirir.

Dolmabahçe Koleksiyonu’nun Zarif İncisi

Parfumane Dolmabahçe Koleksiyonu, Osmanlı saraylarının zarafetini modern parfüm sanatına taşıyan özel bir seridir. Lalezar Parfümü, bu koleksiyonun en romantik temsilcisidir. El işçiliğiyle üretilen kristal kesimli cam şişesi, Fransız ikonu sprey pompası ve yeniden doldurulabilir tasarımıyla hem nostaljik hem sürdürülebilir bir deneyim sunar. Altın detaylı şişe kapağı, parfümün lüks karakterini yansıtırken; kutu tasarımı, Dolmabahçe Sarayı’nın çiçek motiflerinden ilham alır.

Koku Kompozisyonu — Zarafetin Dili

LALEZAR, klasik çiçek notalarının modern bir yorumudur. İlk anda hissedilen gül ağacı ve şeftali notaları, kadifemsi bir tazelikle açılır. Ardından gelen yasemin, gül ve iris notaları; kokuya zarif bir derinlik, duygusal bir sıcaklık ve romantik bir dokunuş kazandırır. Alt notalardaki tonka fasulyesi, vanilya ve misk, çiçeksi zarafeti sıcak bir temel üzerine oturtur. Parfümün genel yapısı, hem narin hem büyüleyici, hem de etkileyici bir dengeye sahiptir.

  • Üst Notalar: Gül Ağacı, Şeftali
  • Orta Notalar: Yasemin, Gül, İris
  • Alt Notalar: Tonka Fasulyesi, Vanilya, Animalic, Misk

Lalezar’ın Zarif Ruhunu Keşfedin

Lalezar Parfümü, doğanın en saf çiçek kokularını, kadınsı zarafetle birleştirir. Şeftalinin tatlı meyvemsi enerjisi, gül ağacının asil tonlarıyla birleşir. Yasemin’in büyüleyici çekiciliği ve iris’in pudralı dokusu, parfüme romantik bir karakter kazandırır. Tonka ve vanilya alt yapısı ise, bu zarif çiçeksi dünyayı sıcak, yumuşak ve kalıcı bir hale getirir. Bu koku, adeta bir bahar sabahında açan lalelerin ve taze güllerin büyüleyici uyumunu taşır.

Kalıcılık ve Kullanım Deneyimi

Lalezar Eau de Parfum, yüksek esans oranı sayesinde tende 10–14 saat boyunca kalıcılığını korur. İlk birkaç saat boyunca çiçeksi notalar belirgin bir yayılım sergiler, ardından misk ve vanilya tabanı devreye girer. Gün içinde tene yakın, yumuşak bir zarafet bırakır. Günlük kullanımda huzurlu bir tazelik; özel davetlerde ise şık ve romantik bir duruş sağlar. Unisex karakterine rağmen, zarif yönüyle özellikle kadın parfüm koleksiyonlarında özel bir yere sahiptir.

Şişe Tasarımı ve El İşçiliği

Lalezar’ın şişesi, Osmanlı bahçelerindeki lalelerden esinlenmiştir. Kristal kesimli yüzeyler, ışığı zarifçe yansıtarak tıpkı bir çiçek yaprağının sabah çiyiyle parladığı anı hatırlatır. Altın püskürtme pompası, klasik Fransız parfüm geleneğini yaşatırken; yeniden doldurulabilir tasarımıyla çevreci bir lüks deneyimi sunar. Her detay, parfümün hem estetik hem de duygusal değerini artırır.

İstanbul’un Bahar Esintisi

LALEZAR, İstanbul’un ilkbahar sabahlarını kokusuyla canlandırır. Boğaz esintisiyle taşınan çiçek kokuları, şehirdeki zarif bahçelerin atmosferini hatırlatır. Gül, yasemin ve iris birleşerek hem geçmişin Osmanlı zarafetini hem de bugünün modern kadın ruhunu temsil eder. Bu koku, İstanbul’un bahar mevsimi gibi — canlı, zarif, huzurlu ve büyüleyici.

Kullanım Önerileri

  • Gündüz: Boyun ve bilek çevresine 2–3 fıs; taze ve çiçeksi bir enerji sağlar.
  • Akşam: Elbise veya saç uçlarına 4–5 fıs; tonka ve vanilya notalarının derinliğini öne çıkarır.
  • Kalıcılık: 10–14 saat arası.
  • Karakter: Çiçeksi, pudralı, tatlı, zarif.

Bakım ve Saklama

Parfümü doğrudan güneş ışığından uzak, serin ve kuru bir ortamda saklayın. Kuru ciltlerde nemlendirici kullanmak, kokunun tene daha iyi tutunmasını sağlar. Kıyafetlere 15–20 cm mesafeden püskürtün; bu şekilde hem homojen dağılım hem de kalıcı bir etki elde edersiniz. Zamanla parfümdeki doğal yağlar olgunlaşarak kokunun derinliğini artırır.

Keşfetmeye Devam Et

Daha fazla doğal ve kalıcı parfüm deneyimi için Tüm Ürünler sayfasını ziyaret edebilir veya Fragrantica – Parfumane profilinde markamızın uluslararası parfüm mirasını keşfedebilirsiniz.

Lalezar Parfüm, bahar çiçeklerinin zarif armonisini, tonka ve vanilyanın sıcaklığıyla buluşturan lüks bir eserdir. Her damlasında doğallık, romantizm ve zarafet vardır. Bu koku, Osmanlı bahçelerinden ilham almış, modern zarafetin sembolü olarak Parfumane Dolmabahçe Koleksiyonu’nun en özel parfümlerinden biridir.

In the dry-down, patchouli and musk anchor the perfume, leaving an irresistible trail of warmth and sensual sophistication. The combination of nutmeg’s spice and vetiver’s earthiness brings balance, while the final phase of patchouli and musk ensures a smooth, long-lasting dry-down. The result is understated luxury — an object that feels powerful in its simplicity, timeless in its beauty.

The Spirit of Istanbul Nights

Parfumane Oud Collection — The Essence of Timeless Luxury

Parfumane’s Oud Collection brings together nature’s most precious ingredient, agarwood (oud), with a range of complementary essences that reveal its many dimensions. From smoky and spicy to floral and velvety, each perfume tells its own story. Bouquet Oud stands out as the most romantic and elegant member of this collection. The graceful notes of rose and saffron embrace the mystical warmth of oud, while amber and vanilla add a sweet, sensual depth. The result is an oriental floral masterpiece — luxurious, delicate, and irresistibly refined.

Fragrance Profile — The Harmony of Rose and Oud

Bouquet Oud opens with the pure and bold character of agarwood, setting a luxurious and mysterious tone. In the heart, rose reveals its soft, romantic bloom, while saffron adds a golden glow of spice. The base notes of sandalwood, amber, and vanilla bring creamy warmth and longevity, complemented by a hint of sugar cane that lends a gentle gourmand sweetness.   • Heart Notes: Rose, Saffron
  • Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Sugar Cane

Elegance, Romance, and Serenity

Bouquet Oud celebrates the duality of strength and softness. The rose embodies tenderness and grace, while oud conveys confidence and depth. The golden thread of saffron bridges these contrasts, giving the fragrance a refined oriental warmth. It is a unisex perfume — elegant on women, magnetic on men. On the skin, it tells a personal story: gentle at first, then passionate, and finally serene. This balance makes Bouquet Oud a true signature scent for those who appreciate beauty in every detail.

Longevity and Projection

Being an Extrait De Parfum, Bouquet Oud offers exceptional longevity — lasting 15–20 hours on the skin and even longer on fabric. It evolves gracefully throughout the day: the initial oud intensity mellows into rose and saffron, finally melting into a soft, creamy base. Its sillage is elegant yet noticeable, leaving behind a subtle trail of sophistication. It’s the kind of perfume that turns heads quietly — never loud, but always remembered.

Design and Bottle Aesthetics

The bottle of Bouquet Oud mirrors its refined soul — minimalist yet luxurious. Dark glass protects the perfume’s natural richness, while golden accents emphasize its regal character. Each bottle is hand-filled and individually numbered, ensuring authenticity and exclusivity. The design captures Parfumane’s core philosophy: understated opulence and natural elegance. It’s not merely a perfume; it’s a collectible work of art.

How to Wear Bouquet Oud

  • Daytime: Apply 2–3 sprays for a light, floral presence. Perfect for spring and summer days.
  • Evening: 4–5 sprays highlight the deeper oud and amber tones — ideal for romantic dinners or formal occasions.
  • Season: Suitable for all seasons but shines especially in cooler months when warmth and richness bloom.
  • Layering: Combine with vanilla or musk-based perfumes to enhance its sweetness and longevity.

Sensory Experience — A Sweet and Refined Oriental Journey

Bouquet Oud creates an olfactory experience that feels like stepping into a floral garden touched by golden light. The oud forms the foundation, grounding the fragrance with depth and intensity. Rose brings elegance and emotional warmth, while saffron adds a luxurious exotic nuance. The vanilla and sugar cane in the base offer a delicate gourmand finish, evoking comfort and sophistication in equal measure. This scent feels both romantic and confident — an ode to timeless allure.

Texture and Atmosphere

The texture of Bouquet Oud is smooth, silky, and multidimensional. It transitions from airy floral tones to velvety woodiness, wrapping the wearer in a cocoon of calm confidence. The sweetness is never overwhelming — it’s elegant, like the warmth of a candlelit evening. Each note plays a role: rose for grace, saffron for intensity, oud for mystery, and vanilla for serenity. This perfect interplay makes Bouquet Oud a perfume of balance and beauty.

Storage and Care

Keep your Bouquet Oud away from direct sunlight, in a cool and dry environment. Over time, natural ingredients like oud and rose oil mature gracefully, deepening the scent’s richness. Bouquet Oud is not just a perfume; it’s an emotion bottled in glass. It captures the essence of love, refinement, and serenity. It’s designed for dreamers, romantics, and aesthetes — for those who believe fragrance is an invisible form of art.
